task.description: Independently verify BACKEND-DEV's fix for ISS-0612/GH-556 (provisioning.zig advisory-lock scope bug). BACKEND-DEV already ran zig build test twice (939/1003 pass, 64 skip, matching baseline) and a 12-thread concurrent stress test twice (96/96 complete in ~2.2s, vs. the original 24/96-stall-at-180s-cap before the fix) -- re-run these independently to confirm. BACKEND-DEV also discovered and fixed a second-order interaction: tests/unit/test_api08_auth.zig's ensureTenantDefaultSchema() (added by ISS-0209) had grown its own redundant/conflicting outer lock around the same key on a separate connection, relying on the pre-fix lock being a no-op -- this was removed since provisionTenantSchema()'s own (now-correct) lock provides the guarantee ISS-0209 needed. Verify this removal didn't reintroduce the original ISS-0209 DROP-SCHEMA-CASCADE race (re-read docs/anti-patterns.md's ISS-0209 entry and confirm test_api08_auth.zig's current state doesn't have that destructive fallback re-appear). Also add a Pool.release() defense-in-depth check: confirm pg_advisory_unlock_all() is actually called by writing/running a quick check that a connection returned to the pool while erroneously still holding a session lock gets its lock cleared.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-env-verify exits 0 (test environment healthy)
zig build test exits 0, pass/skip counts match or improve on the 939/1003 baseline, run at least 2 times
The 12-thread concurrent stress test (tests/integration/iss0129_migration_run_advisory_lock_test.zig) completes 96/96 with no stalls, run at least 2 times
No advisory locks or non-idle backends remain in bpm_test after each run
test_api08_auth.zig does not have the ISS-0209 destructive DROP SCHEMA CASCADE fallback re-introduced

result.summary: Independently re-verified BACKEND-DEV fix for ISS-0612/GH-556. Pre-checks: docker-compose services healthy, zig build migrate exit 0 (108/108 applied, no drift), zig build test-env-verify HEALTHY (10/10 checks). zig build test --summary all run twice: 939/1003 passed, 64 skipped, 0 failed both times -- exact match to BACKEND-DEV baseline. zig build test-integration-iss0129 (12-thread x 8-round same-tenant stress test) run twice: 96/96 calls completed in 3326ms then 2254ms, 0 non-retryable errors, 7/7 tests passed both times -- no stalls, well under the 180s pre-fix stall cap (pre-fix: stalled at 24/96). DB checked clean after both stress runs: 0 non-idle backends, 0 stray advisory locks. Re-read docs/anti-patterns.md ISS-0209 entry and confirmed tests/unit/test_api08_auth.zig has no DROP SCHEMA/TABLE/TRUNCATE/CASCADE tokens -- ensureTenantDefaultSchema() is the clean bounded-backoff retry loop with the redundant self-deadlocking outer lock correctly removed. Read src/db/pool.zig and confirmed clearConnectionAdvisoryLocks() (pg_advisory_unlock_all(), marks connection invalid on failure) is wired into Pool.release() unconditionally, after resetConnectionSearchPath and before idle-set insertion, on every release path -- confirmed empirically via 0 stray locks after 192 total acquire/release cycles across both stress runs. Cleaned up 2 orphaned workspace-2 test.exe stragglers (verified ExecutablePath before each kill); left all sibling-workspace (ai-dala\R-Co, no \2\) processes untouched.
